posts.caption:
Shot inside a working showroom. No set, no downtime, no closing the store.

shelves, reflective everything. You solve it with lens choice and where you stand,
not in post.

Retail and in-store content across Pakistan.

the product actually is. So this one stays on what it is, how it's taken, and who
it's for. Nothing beyond that.
